fragments.derivationNote: Pinned project-owned OHM capture of the 1521-1537 Grand Moscow state, promoted only through the archive-geometry recipe after independent settlement controls and corroboration against Tornau's public-domain 1240-1533 sheet. This remains a low-confidence historical reconstruction, not a surveyed early-modern cadastral boundary.

baseStates.notes: Operational coverage begins at the final month of 1521 rather than fabricating an intra-year transition. The selected source feature is explicitly bounded 1521-1537, so this verified state is conservatively used only through 1536-12.
